messages:
jules: quick postmortem follow-up — hit a short outage window when DNS TTLs and LB cache combined during a cross-region cutover. documenting actions.
kevin: paste the minimal packet/log snippet so we can see the client retry pattern?
jules: dropping the timeline
jules: ```
2026-03-27T11:41:02Z client->edge resolved old-ip (ttl=300)
2026-03-27T11:41:03Z dns update -> new-ip published but old caches still served
2026-03-27T11:41:05Z lb-edge cache held old backend mapping -> 502s observed as backend drained
2026-03-27T11:41:07Z client retries amplified error spikes for ~60s
```
rita: TL;DR: several layers (public DNS TTL, internal LB cache TTL, and sidecar host cache) all had long TTLs. during fast failover the stale entries caused misrouted traffic and retries.
kevin: mitigation ideas: 1) reduce public DNS TTL for dynamic targets during maintenance windows 2) add pre-warm step to update LB caches before traffic flip 3) add DNS-update-ack from edge caches before cutover
jules: immediate actions agreed: A) lower internal LB cache TTL to 30s for dynamic targets B) add a preflight probe to validate LB cache entries C) add alert for stale-dns/cache mismatch
dns-bot: DNS change queued: reduce external-dns TTL for target-set-b from 300 -> 60 seconds at 2026-03-28T01:00:00Z
kevin: i'll own the LB cache TTL change + pre-warm probe. ETA: 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/536
rita: i'll add a small synthetic probe that runs from two regions to confirm DNS/IP parity before cutover. ETA: 2026-03-28 04:00 UTC
infra-oncall: prefer applying changes in low-traffic window (01:00-04:00 UTC). will coordinate and watch errors for 1h post-change.
jules: owners & deadlines (recorded in PM): - kevin: LB cache TTL + pre-warm probe -> ETA 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC - rita: synthetic cross-region DNS parity probe -> ETA 2026-03-28 04:00 UTC - jules: postmortem doc update + 90-day incident-pattern review -> ETA 2026-03-30 10:00 PT
kevin: adding rollback plan in PR: quick revert to previous cache TTL and disable pre-warm if any regressions.
dns-bot: public DNS TTL change applied at 2026-03-28T01:02:12Z
deploy-bot: infra PR 536 merged and deploy dq-2240 started at 2026-03-28T02:23:11Z
deploy-bot: deploy dq-2240 succeeded at 2026-03-28T02:29:41Z
infra-oncall: verified metrics for 30m post-deploy; stale-cache alerts suppressed and TLS/502 errors within baseline. will leave follow-up check 2026-03-30 10:00 PT.
jules: recurring-note: saw similar DNS/cache mismatch incidents on 2025-10-08 and 2026-01-29. adding recurring-pattern review and a runbook step to always run parity probes before any cross-region LB flip.
rita: runbook stub created: https://docs.internal/runbooks/dns-lb-parity-check
kevin: tests green in staging. will mark task done after next week's canary flip.
jules: thanks all — follow-up sync scheduled 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. please update the PM doc when items complete. :thumbsup:
